title: निकटघटक विश्लेषण
nepali: निकटघटक विश्लेषण वाक्यविश्लेषणको संरचनावादी अवधारणा हो । यसमा वाक्यमा आएका पदहरूको निकटताका आधारमा घटकीय विश्लेषण गरिन्छ । वाक्यसम्बन्धी गहन अध्ययन विश्लेषण अंग्रेजी र संस्कृत दुबैतर्फ भएको छ । भाषाविज्ञानका क्षेत्रमा  संरचनावादी भाषावैज्ञानिक ब्लुमफिल्डले वाक्य विश्लेषणको यो अवधारणा प्रस्तावित गरेका हुन् । वाक्यभित्रका घटकहरूको विश्लेषण संस्कृत व्याकरण र साहित्यशास्त्रमा पनि चर्चा भएको विषय हो । यस पद्धतिमा वाक्यका संरचक घटकहरूमध्ये कुनचाहिं घटक कुनचाहिं घटकको नजिक रहेको छ भन्ने विश्लेषण हुन्छ । घटकीय विश्लेषणका क्रममा संरचनालाई द्विधा विभाजन गरिन्छ । यसको विश्लेषणका वृक्षारेख, ऊध्र्वरेख, बाकस, धर्का र कोष्ठ गरी पाँच पद्धति मानिएका छन् । अनुक्रम मिलेको संरचनाको विश्लेषण गर्न सकिए तापनि भग्नक्रममा रहेका संरचनाको विश्लेषण गर्न समस्या देखिएकाले वाक्य विश्लेषणका नवीन अवधारणाहरूको विकास भएको हो ।
american_english: Immediate constituent analysis is a structuralist concept of sentence analysis. In it, component analysis is carried out on the basis of the proximity of the words that appear in a sentence. In-depth study and analysis of the sentence have been done on both the English and Sanskrit sides. In the field of linguistics, the structuralist linguist Bloomfield proposed this concept of sentence analysis. The analysis of constituents within a sentence is also a topic discussed in Sanskrit grammar and literary theory. In this method, an analysis is made of which constituent among the constitutive components of a sentence is close to which constituent. In the course of component analysis, the structure is divided into two parts. For its analysis, five methods are recognized: tree diagram, vertical line, box, bracket, and parentheses. Although structures with a matching sequence can be analyzed, because problems are seen in analyzing structures that are in a broken sequence, new concepts of sentence analysis have been developed.

In-depth study and analysis of the sentence have been done on both the English and Sanskrit sides. In the field of linguistics, the structuralist linguist Bloomfield put forward this concept of sentence analysis. The analysis of constituents within a sentence is also a topic discussed in Sanskrit grammar and literary theory. informal_english: Immediate constituent analysis is a structuralist way of looking at sentence analysis. In it, you break things down based on how close the words in a sentence sit next to each other. Sentences have been studied and analysed in depth on both the English and Sanskrit sides. In the field of linguistics, the structuralist linguist Bloomfield came up with this concept of sentence analysis. Breaking down the bits inside a sentence is also something that's talked about in Sanskrit grammar and literary theory. With this method, you work out which part among the building blocks of a sentence is sitting closest to which other part. During component analysis, the structure gets split into two. For analysing it, five methods are recognised: tree diagram, vertical line, box, bracket, and parentheses. While you can analyse structures with a matching sequence just fine, there have been hassles analysing structures that are in a broken sequence, so new concepts of sentence analysis have been developed.
